scripts.build: npm run configure && astro build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run configure && node --check workers/booking/src/index.mjs && node --check workers/booking/src/session.mjs && node --check workers/booking/src/browser.mjs
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/configure.mjs --deploy && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.jsonc
